result.rationale: The save action in embeddable-host.js.es6 reads `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` (null for a new host with no category chosen) and after saving sets `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`, ignoring the server response. Meanwhile the controller's `save_host` normalizes a blank category_id to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and serializes the persisted host. So the client's category lookup uses the stale null categoryId instead of the server-returned canonical one, leaving the UI showing no category after save — the mechanism is fully trac

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug. In embeddable-host.js.es6 line 38, after saving, the code does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`. The categoryId is initialized to null (line 9) and only set when editing an existing host (line 26). For a new host, categoryId remains null, so findById(null) returns undefined/null, causing the UI to show no category. However, the server-side save_host method (embeddable_hosts_controller.rb lines 23-24) sets category_id to uncategorized_category_id when blank. This creates a mismatch where the server saves the correct category but the client displays nothing.
